I'm currently experimenting with my work schedule & attempting to transition from part-time to full. I'm a self employed contractor & can do what I want regarding breaks, lunch, and general schedule. 

What have you all found works best for focus, mood, productivity, etc?

I'm currently using a pomodoro timer to take a 5min stretch break after each 40 minute focus block. 

#work #coding #programming #focus #productivity

[ ] Longer lunch, end work later
[ ] Shorter lunch, end work earlier
[ ] More small breaks throughout the day
[ ] Other: will explain in replies
